body:
When it comes to choosing a dresser for your child's room, there are a lot of factors to consider. Obviously, you want a dresser that’s stylish, functional, and durable. You want plenty of storage, and anti-tip hardware to help keep baby safe. But beyond the obvious are the details - the little (sometimes hidden) features that make a big difference in the way you use your dresser (and how long you’ll keep using it)!

So today, we wanted to take a minute to highlight some of the less-than-obvious features that make our dressers some of the best around. They might not be the features you walk into a store shopping for, but they ARE the ones that will turn a dresser you like into a part of your nursery you truly love. You’ll find some of them (and sometimes all of them) on every dresser in our collection.

Without further ado - here’s to the unsung features we love!

Here’s to Soft-Close Drawers:

Designed to close gently and quietly, soft-close drawers are a two-for-one feature. The gentle close helps make sure no tiny fingers or toes are ever pinched, and the quiet close means you can put away laundry during naptime without worrying about waking a sensitive sleeper.

Here’s to the Dust Panel:

We’re willing to bet this is the first you’ve heard about the dust panel. This extra bit of protection at the base of your dresser stops dust from entering drawers from below. Without the dust panel, dust on the floors from pets, spills, shoes, and the mess of life can travel upward in your dresser drawers. But with it, baby’s clothes stay clean and more allergen free!

Here’s to the Forged Steel Support:

Beyond just sounding extra cool and tough, the forged steel support built into a dadada Baby dresser provides extra stability and durability that helps it survive moves, room rearrangements, and generations worth of storage. Fewer cracks or breaks, more trustworthy strength, and more years of reliable use!

Here’s to Solid Wood Legs:

dadada Baby solid wood dresser legs are beautiful, but they’re so much more than that. Cleverly designed (and often angled) to provide extra stability, wood makes a sturdy foundation that’s kind to floors and built to last. Whether painted, stained, or natural wood, these gorgeous examples of form and function pull from their past lives as trees to keep your dresser firmly planted.

Here’s to Natural Handles:

We love a natural touch in a nursery. Warm neutral tones in nature-made materials like wood or leather are lovely to look at, nice to touch, and durable through years of use. Our solid wood or natural leather handles are high quality, easy to pull, and even teething-toddler friendly.

Here’s to Super Deep Drawers:

There’s nothing more frustrating than wasted storage space, so dadada Baby drawers are careful to take advantage of every available nook and cranny. Our extra-deep drawers have more than enough space for all your baby essentials (with room to grow!)

Here’s to Drawer Clearance:

Deep drawers aren’t much good if you can’t reach the back half of them. dadada Baby drawers have full clearance, which means they open enough to allow you to reach the back of the drawer without threatening the stability of the dresser. No more lost socks squished in the back - the whole drawer is yours!

Here’s to the little things that make a big difference in the rooms and lives of our little humans! What’s the feature that let you know your dadada Baby dresser was the one? Was it style, size, color, or storage space? Or was it one of these smaller, hidden details that sealed the deal?

Show us a photo of your dadada Baby dresser at home in your nursery with the #dadadaBabydresserlove
